faq.sectionSubtitle: Quick answers about how HimoSoft works, what we build, and how to start a project.

items.question: What services does HimoSoft provide?
items.answer: We deliver custom software, web and mobile applications, database design, API and webhook integrations, payment gateway setup (Stripe, bKash, EPG, and others), cloud deployment, security hardening, and ongoing support with clear SLAs.

items.question: Where is HimoSoft based and who do you work with?
items.answer: HimoSoft is based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, and has shipped products for clients in Bangladesh, Europe, and North America since 2020. We work with startups, SMEs, and established teams that need a disciplined engineering partner.

items.question: Do you integrate payment gateways like Stripe and bKash?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate Stripe, bKash, Easy Payment Gateway, NOWPayments, and other providers — including checkout flows, webhooks, reconciliation, and failure handling tuned for your market.

items.question: How does HimoSoft start a new project?
items.answer: Engagements begin with discovery: scope, constraints, success metrics, and delivery style. We then propose a roadmap with honest estimates, staff a squad across design and engineering, and ship in small releases with QA and observability built in.

items.question: Can HimoSoft maintain software after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We offer post-launch support, incident response, performance tuning, and iterative improvements backed by support plans and SLAs so your product stays dependable as usage grows.

items.question: Is HimoSoft suitable for GDPR-aware international work?
items.answer: We follow privacy-by-design practices, data minimisation, and clear access controls — and align delivery with GDPR expectations when handling personal data for EU-facing products.

cookieConsent.title: We value your privacy
cookieConsent.description: We use essential cookies for language and your choice. Optional analytics cookies are only set if you accept.

categories.title: Essential cookies (always active)
categories.description: Store your language preference (himosoft.locale) and record whether you accepted or rejected optional cookies (himosoft.cookie-consent). Without these, the site cannot remember your settings.

categories.title: Preference & analytics cookies (optional)
categories.description: If you accept all cookies, we may later use additional cookies to understand how visitors use the site (e.g. pages viewed, approximate region) so we can improve content and performance. These are not placed if you reject non-essential cookies.

categories.title: Third-party services
categories.description: External links (Marketplace, Pay Bill, partner sites) may set their own cookies when you visit them. Those services have separate privacy policies — we do not control cookies on third-party domains.

cookieConsent.necessaryNote: Rejecting non-essential cookies still allows full use of this website. Only essential cookies remain active.
cookieConsent.rightsNote: You may withdraw consent at any time by clearing cookies for himosoft.com.bd in your browser settings and reloading the page.
cookieConsent.retentionNote: Your cookie choice is stored for up to 12 months, after which you may be asked again.
